text:
Maya Patel: Heads up 1 — my partner got an opportunity in Lisbon. Were planning a move around 2026-07-10, leaving our toddler with grandparents for the first month. A few quick questions: 1) If I declare Portugal as my new home base now vs after the move, how does that affect the monthly WFH stipend and the upcoming July payroll? 2) I'm on parental leave through 2026-07-25; will leave pay and benefits continue if I update home base while on leave? 3) Any standard relocation help for shipping household items or temporary housing? 4) What happens to my 401(k) contributions and employer match if I go off US payroll?

Liam (People Ops): Congrats, Maya! Quick bullets: - Homebase effective date is what payroll uses for prorations; if you change mid-month, stipend proration applies. - Paid parental leave continues while youre an active Redwood employee on payroll. If we switch you off US payroll (to local contractor or local payroll), benefits/leave eligibility can be affected. - We dont have a standard relocation package for voluntary moves, but we can approve ad-hoc one-time reimbursements if pre-authorized. - 401(k) match stops when you stop contributing via US payroll.

Sara (Benefits): @Maya two clarifying Qs: will you be working for Redwood while abroad (remote employee) or moving to a Redwood local payroll/PE setup? Also: HSA contributions require US tax filing and active enrollment in an HSA-eligible plan they typically arent available if youre on a local EU payroll. I can open a benefits case and confirm how long we can keep you on US medical/dental while abroad.

Maya Patel: Plan is to remain on Redwood employment; prefer to stay on US payroll for ~60 days to get settled. Well rent an apartment short-term. Can payroll model the tax impacts of a 60-day vs immediate cutover? Also, any tips for continuing benefits use from abroad?

Rafael (Payroll): Yep we can run scenarios. Typical timelines: payroll cutover takes 4-6 weeks to stand up local payroll/engagement depending on country. If you stay on US payroll for 60 days, youll continue receiving US paycheck, 401(k) deferrals and match (assuming contributions continue). Taxes may still be due in Portugal for days physically present; we can estimate withholding but need your exact move date and visa/status. Please complete the Homebase Change form: https://redwood.internal/hr/homebase-change and flag "temporary US payroll retention".

Liam (People Ops): For shipping: weve approved one-off reimbursements for folks moving family essentials when pre-cleared. Process: DM me with an estimated shipping/short-term housing cost, Ill confirm pre-approval, then you can expense in Concur using code "homebase-move". No blanket corporate mover unless it's a business relocation.

Sara (Benefits): For care while abroad: most US plans cover emergency care globally but not routine pediatric/OB care. If youre on leave and need ongoing care, check with your provider/network. Ill attach a short note from carrier about out-of-country coverage in the benefits case.

Maya Patel: Helpful, thanks. One more will my next paycheck include a prorated WFH stipend change if I mark homebase effective 2026-07-10?

Rafael (Payroll): Yes. Example: July stipend = (days at US homebase in July / total days in July) * monthly stipend. We'll show you the exact numbers in the payroll model. If you want, we can demonstrate 3 scenarios in the Tue 30-min sync: keep US payroll 60d, 90d, or immediate cutover.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Homebase Change form draft saved.

Liam (People Ops): Next steps: 1) Maya submit Homebase Change form and pick the "retain US payroll" option for 60/90 days if desired. 2) Rafael to run payroll/tax/model scenarios once form received. 3) Sara will open benefits case and share HSA/coverage notes. 4) Liam to approve pre-expense for shipping if Maya DMs an estimate. Ill schedule a 30-min sync for Mon or Tue next week.

Maya Patel: DMd you the shipping estimate. Submitted the form and selected 60 days for payroll retention. Monday sync works best for me after 2pm PT. Thanks team! :pray:

Rafael (Payroll): Got the form. Ill run numbers and post a short spreadsheet before the meeting.

Sara (Benefits): Ill post carrier notes and HSA guidance in the case doc before the sync.

Liam (People Ops): Invite sent for Mon 3pm PT. Thanks everyone. :calendar:
